title.narrative: WGG- Building Inclusive Movements and Alliances in India

description.narrative: It is a strategic platform for activists to participate in and learn about differing viewpoints, form creative alliances and highlight issues that are generally considered to be beyond the purview of women’s rights and gender justice.

sector.narrative: Support for feminist, women-led and women's rights organisations and movements, and institutions (governmental and non-govermental) at all levels to enhance their effectiveness, influence and substainability (activities and core-funding). These organisations exist to bring about transformative change for gender equality and/or the rights of women and girls in developing countries. Their activities include agenda-setting, advocacy, policy dialogue, capacity development, awareness raising and prevention, service provision, conflict-prevention and peacebuilding, research, organising, and alliance and network building

15 Local level Panchayat Meetings where women collective and young girls, WGWDs are participating to Advocacy for their rights . 2 block level interface meetings with block officials and police, one online campaign (12 girls and women joined this campaign through phone, one campaign on 16 days of activism-Advocacy was carried out at community, panchayat, block, district, state level to spread understanding and awareness on the issues of gender based violence. On 10 ocassions WWDs participate along with YWLs at panchayat level advocacy initiatives to raise their issues related to SRHR, access to govt schemes and violence against women. Local Level and state level opportunities

Gramonnati hosted. 8 Panchayat level meetings, 7 block level meetings, 1 district level meeting, 1 state level meeting,1 campaign to create understanding and awareness on issues of gender and intersectionality, especially with women with disability and young girls, getting accessibility and availability for entitlement of women with disability; at the state level workshop, there was also recommendation around policy for women with disability and gender based violence. Aakanksha Seva Sadan hosted one State level rethink event with 70 participants(YW:10, WWD:10, WWD Organization: 03, State Level WRO and other WROs: 35), and 15 Local level panchayat meetings where women collectives and young girls are participating to advocate for their rightsYuva hosted two state level events(including one rethink event on GBV with WROs and WWDs) with 35 and 51 people respectively, 12 local level event with 250 People, with participation from police stations, women’s collective, school girls, and young women.
Local Level and state level opportunities

Partner CSO provided multiple opportunities to YWLs and WWDs to participate in various advocacy platrorms. Specifically through the following events: 16 Days Activism, Gender Fair, Annual Rethink Event, Interface meeting, Exposer visit, Community Level Program, Menstrual Hygiene Day, Rajya Sabha and Legislative Assembly, Youth Day, Kisan Mela programs organized by other organizations, MNREGA Day, Mahila Sabha and Gram Sabha, Sarkar Aapke Dwar Program. Some of the example of the participation of YWLs and WWDs in various advocacy platforms is mentioned below:As part of a cross-learning visit at the district level, participants visited the Women’s Police Station, Cyber Crime Police Station, One Stop Center, and Shubham Divyang Sansthan. Four adolescent girls with disabilities took part in this visit. Cross learning visits to District, Mahila Police Station, District Legal Office, CWC Hospital etc. were conducted. Rights of persons with disabilities and girls were discussed.
